summary.text: Wind Suction Life Twister is Nie Kuang Feng's signature killer move. Nie Kuang Feng names it after a green tornado condenses into a ball and traps Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch.

claims.text: Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch pauses as wild winds blow and wind blades surround him. He snorts and shoots crystal frost qi that destroys the blades. Nie Kuang Feng arrives at once. It is a green tornado to begin with. It condenses into a ball and bursts with suction force. Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch wants to dodge and cannot. He is trapped in the tornado. Extreme ice crystal light immortal suppression coffin is already too late to use.

Nie Kuang Feng laughs wildly. It says it spent thirty years creating the move and a hundred years modifying it, and that nobody has survived against it. Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch’s expression is grim. He can only activate defensive killer moves. His arms, covered in thick ice crystals, are absorbed into Nie Kuang Feng’s body and last a few moments before they disintegrate, shredded into particles. His body is next.

Black lightning tribulations strike Nie Kuang Feng during the draw. The suction force stops for a moment, then resumes, pulling Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch in inch by inch. After repeated strikes, Nie Kuang Feng cannot draw him in. Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch retreats.
